deallocator.description: function that frees a linked node object

unlinker.description: function that detaches a linked node from its container/tree by updating parent/prev/next links

linked_node.description: struct type representing a node in a linked tree or container

content_consumer.description: function that consumes or copies content from a linked node

adder.description: function that adds a node to a container/tree, possibly freeing the node after consuming its content

content_field.description: field of a linked node whose content is consumed
